Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

◈ SYSTEM: "35. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."

With Haven grieving again, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
